column3: “Like David his ancestor” is rendered “as his father David had done.”
“Made smoke” is rendered “burned incense,” and “luxuriant tree” as “green tree.”
The Hebrew reads “Rezin king of Aram … to Aram” and “Edomites” (reading tradition); NASB has “Arameans” (written text). NASB adds “entirely.”
“Offered up on it” is rendered “went up to it.”
“Made smoke” is rendered “burned,” and “drink offering” as “libation.”
“From the face of the house” is rendered “from the front of the house,” and NASB supplies “his.”
“Make smoke” is rendered “burn,” and “to consult” as “to inquire by.”
“The covered structure of the sabbath” is rendered “the covered way for the sabbath”; the meaning is uncertain.
